the resulting supernatant was subjected to incubation with streptavidin-conjugated beads (GE Healthcare) at 4 °C for 2 h with gentle rocking. Following three washes with ice-cold NETN buffer, the immunocomplexes were eluted with biotin (1 mg ml−1, Sigma) at 4 °C for 1 h. The elutes were further incubated with S-protein beads (EMD Millipore) at 4 °C for 2 h with gentle rocking. The proteins bound to S-protein beads underwent three washes with ice-cold NETN buffer, were resolved on SDS–PAGE, and then subjected to analysis by mass spectrometry.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry experiment described in the text and PRIDE metadata is a discovery-based interactome study (TAP-MS) to identify proteins that associate with TFIP11. While the broader paper performs many differential perturbations (HU treatment, siRNA knockdown of TFIP11/BLM), the specific MS dataset (PXD042222) is an affinity purification of a single stable cell line expressing tagged TFIP11. Therefore, it is not a differential/perturbation proteomics study, and the fallback 'un-classified' label is used.
